command:
cd /tmp/ch1-ref/os && cat > /tmp/ch1-ref/gdb-symbols.txt <<'EOF'
set pagination off
set confirm off
set architecture riscv:rv64
set language rust
info address 'os::clear_bss'
info address 'os::clear_bss::{closure#0}'
info address 'os::sbi::console_putchar'
info address 'os::console::print'
info address 'os::logging::init'
info address 'os::rust_main'
info address 'os::board::{impl#1}::exit'
info address 'os::board::{impl#1}::exit_success'
disassemble /r 'os::clear_bss::{closure#0}'
disassemble /r 'os::sbi::console_putchar'
disassemble /r 'os::board::{impl#1}::exit'
EOF
gdb -nx -q -batch -x /tmp/ch1-ref/gdb-symbols.txt target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/debug/os 2>&1 | sed -n '1,160p'
